title: no multi column form in one area
rule: No multi-column form inside one area — vertical single column is the efficient default; weak grouping may put short related fields on one line, not a second reading column. Card grouping when content is usually more than two screens, each card with a large title.

citation.source: Ant Design — Data entry ; Ant Design — Form research

pass_when: One area is a single reading column (short related fields may share a line). Content usually more than two screens uses titled cards.
fail_when: Two reading columns of fields in one area; or >two-screens dump with no titled cards.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Forms keep-short / one-thing-per-page as a merge. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.length.keep_short` / `forms.layout.single_column`.
